messages.subject: Follow-up | Strategic Value Creation Brief for Ericsson
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Vicente,

Following my earlier introduction, I prepared a concise strategic value brief focused on Ericsson's Southeast Asia, Oceania and India priorities across 5G, AI-native networks, digital infrastructure and skills development.

The paper addresses government and digital-policy alignment, national ecosystem development, secure AI-enabled infrastructure and country-level stakeholder governance. These areas connect closely with my experience across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, regulatory coordination and strategic partnerships.

My executive CV is included in the final three pages. I would welcome a confidential discussion regarding regional or country-facing leadership needs across government relations, external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships or related functions.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com
linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for Ericsson
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Ericsson is advancing AI-native mobile networks while supporting rapid 5G growth across Southeast Asia, Oceania and India. The region combines large-scale network investment, national digitalization programs, spectrum and security policy, workforce development and expanding AI use cases. Ericsson's 2026 portfolio and regional initiatives show a growing need to connect technology leadership with government priorities and ecosystem development. My director-level experience across government relations, regulatory coordination, ESG, corporate affairs and strategic partnerships would support Ericsson by strengthening public-private alignment and translating institutional expectations into accountable country-level execution.
strategic_brief.company_context: Ericsson reported second-quarter 2026 sales of SEK 52.7 billion and an adjusted gross margin of 48.4 percent, while continuing investment in AI-enabled network capabilities. In the Southeast Asia, Oceania and India market area, the company is supporting Vodafone Idea's network evolution, advancing 5G-Advanced with Viettel in Vietnam and building skills partnerships such as Ericsson Educate with Thailand's Digital Economy Promotion Agency. India alone is forecast by Ericsson to reach more than 1.1 billion 5G subscriptions by 2031. These developments place government policy, spectrum, digital inclusion, cybersecurity, talent development and local innovation ecosystems alongside commercial network execution, making coordinated stakeholder governance a material regional capability.

opportunities.title: Government and digital-policy alignment
opportunities.rationale: 5G and AI-native networks depend on spectrum policy, security standards, infrastructure regulation and national digital strategies. Across diverse regional markets, structured engagement with ministries, regulators and public institutions can improve visibility of policy dependencies and connect technology roadmaps with national economic priorities.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would build country stakeholder maps linking ministries, regulators, digital agencies, operators and internal owners, supported by issue registers and executive escalation so public-policy engagement remains connected to business and network-delivery priorities.

opportunities.title: National ecosystem and skills development
opportunities.rationale: Ericsson's partnerships in India and Thailand show the value of combining network investment with skills, startups, education and local innovation. Clear governance around these commitments can strengthen institutional relationships and demonstrate measurable national value beyond equipment and service delivery.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would structure local-value and skills partnerships around measurable outcomes, named owners and evidence, coordinating public institutions, education partners, communities and internal teams so ecosystem commitments support both national priorities and Ericsson's long-term market position.

opportunities.title: Secure AI-enabled infrastructure positioning
opportunities.rationale: AI in RAN and advanced network automation create new performance and efficiency opportunities while increasing attention on security, data governance and infrastructure resilience. Governments and operators need clear evidence connecting technical innovation with trusted operations, energy efficiency and public-interest outcomes.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would help translate technical evidence into institutional and executive narratives suited to regulators, ministries and strategic partners, with clear ownership of security, sustainability and performance claims across technology, legal, communications and public-affairs teams.

opportunities.title: Regional stakeholder risk governance
opportunities.rationale: A market area spanning India, Southeast Asia and Oceania faces different political, regulatory and institutional environments. A common framework for country risks, commitments and external dependencies can improve regional oversight while preserving the local expertise required for customer and government relationships.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would create a concise regional dashboard covering policy, regulatory, stakeholder and local-value issues with named owners and escalation thresholds, giving leadership consistent visibility without weakening country-level accountability.

days_0_30: Map priority countries, institutions, regulators, operators and policy dependencies.
Review material skills, innovation and stakeholder commitments.
Identify external issues with direct commercial, network or reputation impact.
days_31_60: Align government, market, technology and communications engagement plans.
Create a consolidated issue and commitment register with named owners.
Define executive indicators for policy alignment and local ecosystem delivery.
days_61_90: Run focused engagement on priority spectrum, digital-policy and AI infrastructure issues.
Embed periodic regional review of country risks and commitments.
Strengthen evidence controls for security, efficiency and local-value claims.
days_91_180: Scale the governance model across priority markets.
Measure issue closure and commitment performance.
Codify lessons into a repeatable regional stakeholder execution playbook.

potential_impact: Stronger alignment between Ericsson technology priorities and national digital agendas.
Improved visibility across regulatory and stakeholder risks in diverse markets.
More measurable local skills and innovation outcomes.
Faster escalation and resolution of non-technical issues affecting market execution.
background_relevance: Director-level responsibility across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs and executive advisory in a regulated multinational environment.
Direct engagement with ministries, regulators and public institutions around strategic projects and compliance matters.
Experience coordinating external expectations across operations, legal, finance, procurement, environment, HR and leadership teams.
Practical work on public-private relationships, data traceability, local participation and stakeholder governance.
